verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical 320x50 strips that put the legal fine print first, at the far left, at roughly the size of the secondary copy, which inverts the reading order. In both, the 'LONGEST DAY SALE' badge and the phone are microscopic and illegible, and the SOLSTICE logo is faint and crowded by the legal text. B pushes the legal block directly over the visible logo wordmark, a clearer collision, so A is marginally less bad. Each keeps a decent headline, '25% off' line and CTA on the right.
